name: Cupani Metals Corp.
summary: Cupani Metals Corp. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and evaluation of mineral properties in Canada. The company primarily explores for copper, nickel, platinum, palladium, silver, and gold deposits. It also holds a 100% interest in the Blue Lake Cu-Ni-Pt-Pd property, which is located northeast of Schefferville, Quebec. The company was formerly known as IC Capitalight Corp. and changed its name to Cupani Metals Corp. in December 2024. Cupani Metals Corp. was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
